tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open a direct billing URL for an explicitly selected eligible plan: a one-hour Stripe Checkout URL for Free accounts or the existing customer's Stripe billing portal. This always asks the human to confirm the same plan first; a cancellation creates nothing.

tools.name: get_spot_price
tools.description: Return the latest aggregated spot (or GC futures) price for one symbol. Price is a Decimal-formatted string. Latest USD spot price/bid/ask use nearest half-up rounding: XAU 2 decimal places, XAG 3, HG 4. `is_stale` is true when aggregator detected source divergence or stale FX.

tools.name: list_commodities
tools.description: Return the full list of symbols served by this API. Use before get_spot_price / get_historical / get_metadata when you don't know which symbols are supported.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Return provenance metadata for a symbol: aggregated sources, unit, methodology URL, staleness rules. Use for attribution and to document data lineage in downstream reports.

tools.name: get_carat
tools.description: Return per-gram gold (XAU) prices by karat purity — 24k, 22k, 21k, 20k, 18k, 16k, 14k, 10k — in a requested currency (default USD; the same 31 currencies get_spot_price serves). Jewelry-grade pricing computed from XAU spot and exchangerate.dev FX. FREE on every tier — no plan gate. Values are Decima

tools.name: get_historical
tools.description: Return OHLCV bar history for a symbol at 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, or 1d (default). Intraday intervals require Pro. History depth is set automatically by your API key's plan — do NOT pass a tier argument (there is none): Free sees the last 30 days; Physical sees the last year; Pro unlocks full h

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the goldprice.dev FAQ corpus via BM25. Returns top-K matching questions + answers with relevance scores. Use before answering how-to / billing / auth questions so you cite the canonical text instead of guessing from training data.

tools.name: get_forward_view
tools.description: Returns the multi-horizon futures settlement curve for a commodity (XAU, XAG, HG). Every populated horizon up to one year forward. Useful for bot builders and traders seeing the futures-implied path. See https://goldprice.dev/methodology#forward-view-layers for per-layer math.

tools.name: get_physical_price
tools.description: Return the latest per-country physical dealer/retail gold prices — real quotes from dealers, mints, and bullion benchmarks, NOT spot-derived arithmetic — with nullable premium_over_spot_bps per quote (null when live reference inputs are unavailable). `country` is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. ID,

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_docs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the goldprice.dev FAQ corpus via BM25. Returns top-K matching questions + answers with relevance scores. Use before answering how-to / billing / auth que…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_checkout, get_metadata · Private data: get_metadata, get_historical · Public sink: get_forward_view.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_checkout, get_metadata · Private data: get_metadata, get_historical · Public sink: get_forward_view

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_carat" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return per-gram gold (XAU) prices by karat purity — 24k, 22k, 21k, 20k, 18k, 16k, 14k, 10k — in a requested currency (default USD; the same 31 currencies get_spot_price serves). Jewelry-grade pricing computed from live XAU spot + ECB FX. FREE on every tier — no plan gate. Values are Decimal-formatte" → after: "Return per-gram gold (XAU) prices by karat purity — 24k, 22k, 21k, 20k, 18k, 16k, 14k, 10k — in a requested currency (default USD; the same 31 currencies get_spot_price serves). Jewelry-grade pricing computed from XAU spot and exchangerate.dev FX. FREE on every tier — no plan gate. Values are Decima"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
